historical_reproduction_notes.historical_mechanism: Synthetic Gaussian noise random.gauss(0, 0.02) over repeated simulated runs
historical_reproduction_notes.scientific_takeaway: Zero algorithmic regret proves discrete optimization correctness of the solver, while prediction error measures cost model fidelity and physical regret measures hardware performance.
